::: {#def-graph-distance}
#### Distance

Let $u$ and $v$ be vertices of a graph (@def-graph-vertices-edges) or a directed graph (@def-directed-graph),
with a walk (@def-walk) from $u$ to $v$.
The **distance** $\operatorname{dist}(u, v)$ from $u$ to $v$ [@wikipedia_distance_graph_theory]
is the smallest length of a walk from $u$ to $v$.

:::
